sections.title: Purpose of the Software
paragraphs: VidiVerify is a tool for the technical analysis and checking of video and audio files. The software examines technical properties, integrity, structure and other evaluable characteristics and presents the results in a structured form.

All output, notes, ratings and analysis results serve as technical guidance. They are not a guarantee, not an assurance and not a binding statement about a particular condition, a particular usability or a legal assessment.
